name: Kidnapped Girl
source:
The main character, named Clive, considers himself a psychopath. He has long wanted to hurt someone. So Clive kidnapped a girl on his seventeenth birthday. But the victim was more complicated than he'd thought.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公名叫克莱夫，自认为是个精神病态者。他早就想伤害别人，于是在十七岁生日那天，绑架了一名女孩。然而，这名受害者远比他想象中复杂。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274290/]Steam[/url]]
